prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ONLY_DWT_rf', seasonality_champion='ONLY_DWT_rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: ONLY_DWT_rf dominates across all dimensions: perfect trend correlation (1.0), highest seasonal correlation (0.9686), and lowest RMSE (29.31). However, high model disagreement (RMSE spread ratio 70.34) and concept drift detected suggest STL-hierarchical stacking to exploit decomposition structure while handling variance. Early horizon specialist (catboost: 14.63 RMSE) differs from late specialist (DWT_rf: 26.14 RMSE), supporting per-component combination.
